summary: Covista Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing Amendment No. 6 to its August 12, 2021 credit agreement with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent. The amendment reprices all $510 million of outstanding term loans, cutting the Term SOFR margin from 2.25% to 2.00% and the base-rate margin from 1.25% to 1.00%. A 1.00% soft-call premium applies to repricing transactions within six months. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine debt reprice, not a special situation.
